dedupe_keys.name: mca malta mobile quality of service benchmarking 2024 and 2025 drive and walk tests

description: The Malta Communications Authority commissions independent benchmarks of the quality of mobile voice and data services of the mobile operators across Malta and Gozo. Following a public tender in 2024, the specialist firm Systemics-PAB carried out the measurements against internationally recognised standards, and the authority published results for a first benchmark in 2024 and a second in 2025, which also shows whether quality improved. The benchmarks assess voice call success and quality and data services such as web browsing, file transfer, video streaming and real-time communications, by operator and area, from drive and walk tests. Results are published as web pages with charts and a press release, with detailed reports. The authority also publishes periodic key market indicators for the Maltese electronic communications market. Coverage: Malta and Gozo, by operator. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): MCA copyright (terms of use: all material is owned by MCA). Access is free of charge. Caveats: two campaigns only; results are aggregate scores, not raw measurements; area breakdown was not checked. Simulation uses: measured operator performance for Maltese mobile service models and a comparison point for small island networks. Related records: the Digital Decade DESI indicators give Maltese coverage; the Ofcom UK home broadband performance panel and the NMHH market reports give comparable regulator measurements.
